entries.symptom: Error: pg_config executable not found. (pip install psycopg2)
entries.cause: psycopg2 builds from source and needs the PostgreSQL client headers and pg_config, which aren't installed.

entries.symptom: Logging in to self-hosted WunderGraph Cosmo Studio fails: Keycloak says HTTPS required
